name: mydockbar
description: A cross-platform, theme-able application dock for Windows, macOS and Linux.

scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:rust
scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-icons.js && tauri build && node scripts/copy-installer.js
scripts.build:win: node scripts/ensure-icons.js && tauri build --bundles nsis && node scripts/copy-installer.js
scripts.build:mac: node scripts/ensure-icons.js && tauri build --bundles dmg && node scripts/copy-installer.js
scripts.build:linux: node scripts/ensure-icons.js && tauri build --bundles appimage,deb && node scripts/copy-installer.js
